---
title: "Change or cancel a booking"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-11 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Move a booking to another day, time, length or groomer, or cancel it.

## Applies to

Every groomer, when an owner calls to change or cancel.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.

## Procedure

1. Click **Calendar** at the top of the screen. The Calendar screen opens.
2. Click the day of the booking. The day's list opens on the right.

   If you are not sure of the day, open the dog's card and look under the box
   at the top: it shows **Booked** with the day and time. Click **See on the
   calendar** there.

3. Find the booking in the day's list and click **Change or cancel**. The
   **Change** the dog's **booking** form opens.

### Change the booking

4. Change the **Day**, the length, the **Groomer** or the start time, the
   same way as when booking. See [GRM-10 Book a groom](book-a-groom.qmd),
   steps 3 to 7. The service cannot be changed; to change it, cancel this
   booking and book again.
5. Click the **Save** button. It names the new day, time and groomer.

   To leave the booking as it was, click **Keep it as it was**.

### Cancel the booking

4. Click **Cancel this booking** at the bottom right of the form.
5. If useful, click **Why is it cancelled?** and type the reason, for
   example "owner called, dog unwell".
6. Click **Yes, cancel** the dog's **booking**. To keep the booking after
   all, click **Keep it**.

## Result

The Calendar screen shows the booking on its new day and time, or no longer
shows it if it was cancelled.
